info.name: NEXORA Academic Deployment API
info.description:
Postman Collection for NEXORA AI-Powered Retail Demand Forecasting API.
Configured for Academic Demonstration on 21 November 2026.
Deployed via FastAPI and exposed publicly through ngrok HTTPS forwarding tunnel.
Target Public Host: https://antonym-headband-harpist.ngrok-free.dev

variable.description: Base URL of the deployed FastAPI backend. Set to the active public ngrok forwarding HTTPS URL (or http://localhost:8000 for local testing).

header.description: Bypasses the ngrok free-tier browser warning interstitial page.

request.description:
Verifies that the deployed FastAPI process is active and responsive.
Expected: HTTP 200 OK with status: 'healthy'.

request.description:
Verifies that all 4 ML forecasting models (D7, D15, D30, D90) and the historical sales dataset (3,922 SKUs) are initialized and ready for inference.
Expected: HTTP 200 OK with status: 'ready'.

request.description:
Submits SKU '85123A' to generate multi-horizon demand forecasts across 7, 15, 30, and 90 days.
Historical features are automatically calculated from indexed sales records.
Expected: HTTP 200 OK with predictions for D7, D15, D30, and D90.

response.name: 200 Prediction Success
